resumen: The same horizontal pull as with a barbell, but each hand travels on its own and can go lower.
ejecucion: With your torso hinged to about 45° and your back flat, let the dumbbells hang.
Pull both at once, driving your elbows back and close to your body.
Come up until the dumbbells are level with your abdomen.
Lower under control until your arms are fully straight.
The torso neither rises nor falls: if it moves, you are using your back to lift the weight.
matices: Against the barbell, each arm travels on its own and goes slightly lower, which adds a little range. The cited review places rows among the best exercises for middle and lower trapezius; for the lats, vertical pulls still show higher values.
